create_bert_loss_criterion: create a BertLoss criterion that combines masked language model and sentence classification loss
run_bert_loss_forward: run the BertLoss forward method to compute combined MLM and sentence classification loss for a sample
aggregate_bert_loss_logging: aggregate BertLoss logging outputs from data parallel training into normalized per-token and per-sentence metrics
review_bert_loss_forward: review the BertLoss forward method that computes cross-entropy losses for MLM and sentence prediction tasks
review_bert_loss_aggregate: review the BertLoss aggregate_logging_outputs static method that normalizes and sums training metrics across workers
